responsibility: Defines TI C6X’s common target hooks for optimization defaults and exception-unwind selection. It enables C6X-oriented optimization settings such as register renaming, modulo scheduling, and reciprocal-math assumptions, preserves the target’s default flag baseline, and chooses the unwind model used by the compiler—preferring configured SJLJ exceptions when requested and otherwise the target’s native unwind format—before target-specific code generation begins.
